description: This Java interface, EffectedPermissions.java, defines methods and constants related to managing permissions (grant and revoke) within a policies model in the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes factory methods, JSON serialization support, and schema versioning details.

classes.name: EffectedPermissions
classes.description: An interface representing permissions affected by permission effects (grant/revoke) within a policy, providing methods for instantiation, retrieval, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: EffectedPermissions.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing definitions of JSON fields related to EffectedPermissions, including schema version, grant, and revoke fields.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create a new EffectedPermissions instance with specified granted and revoked permissions.

methods.name: getPermissions
methods.description: Retrieve permissions for a specified permission effect (grant or revoke).

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serialize the EffectedPermissions to a JSON object, considering field visibility and schema version.
